opis: In the cosy hallway from the reference picture, by its big ROUND window: the BEAR stands tall and carries the little HEDGEHOG on his shoulders; the HEDGEHOG, now high up by the round window, holds an old brass SPYGLASS to his eye and looks out through the window at the green forest outside, delighted. The BEAR holds the hedgehog's little feet and laughs. Below them the FOX and the SQUIRREL look up at them, laughing and clapping. On the wall beside them a wooden HEIGHT CHART with four short coloured pencil marks at different heights. Warm afternoon light, happy and funny.
